title: Transferring a resolution along a smooth auxiliary base
statement: Let k and R be Noetherian commutative rings with R smooth over k. Let A be finitely presented over k and C finitely presented over R with compatible k-algebra structure, and Λ an R-algebra with compatible k-structure. Suppose α:A→Λ factors as β:A→C and γ:C→Λ, and h_α^k⊆h_γ^R [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution]. If γ at q can be resolved over R, α at q can be resolved over k. With k,R:Type u and A:Type v, assume C:Type(max(u,v)).

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma Tag 07FE, as repaired in lem-weil-pbc-popescu-resolve-separable

proof.text: Unpack the R-resolution C→D→Λ. Give D its composite k-algebra structure; finite presentation is transitive.
Every principal localization of D smooth over R is smooth over k by smooth composition. Taking spans, radicals, images and radicals yields h_D^R⊆h_D^k.
Compose β with C→D. The composite to Λ equals α. The chain h_α^k⊆h_C^R⊆h_D^R⊆h_D^k proves ideal domination, and escape of h_D^R from q implies escape of h_D^k.
